measurements.peak_basis: One p300c ASIC: 120 cores, 4096 ops/cycle, 1.35GHz, LoFi peak; 512GB/s. Mixed-fidelity layer useful work is divided by the whole-device LoFi theoretical peak, not a per-op average. Official p300/QuietBox2 specs and tt-perf-report ArchitectureSpec.
measurements.device_window_basis: FW end minus FW start across ALL layer ops, including gaps. Decode is mean of 128 complete per-replay windows; gaps between separate replays excluded.
measurements.assumptions: Dtypes and fidelity are taken from runtime rows; BF16 norms/residuals, dense active work. BFP tile sizes include exponent headers: BFP4 576 and BFP8 1088 bytes per 1024 elements. Useful FLOPs count all linear projections and causal QK/PV, omit small elementwise work. Estimated DRAM: physical operand/output bytes for every ordinary DRAM op once, active KV once, tile cache updates and page metadata; L1 operands excluded. Includes tile padding, excludes redundant per-core reads and cache reuse. BinaryNg hash-cached prefill shapes are replaced by actual decode B<=32 residual/MLP and KV-norm geometry. Weight reference bytes are informational and not added twice. Percentages are estimates, not counters.

ledger.status: Validated full-stack persistent capacity; measured reduced transient peak with explicit conservative budget
ledger.unit: bytes per ASIC; four identical TP shards

weights.name: tied embedding and vocabulary projection
weights.copy_reason: Allocator construction deltas measure a 704643072-byte lookup and 374341632-byte head. TTNN embedding requires row-major lookup while the selected BFP8 linear head requires tiled transposed vocabulary shards; these cannot alias. Separate representations avoid runtime repacking and fit the measured 1048576-token target pool. The complete terminal device window is 1255.196 us on the real-shape reduced model; see terminal_attribution.json.

ledger.trace_region_note: Reserved separately and already excluded from allocator usable DRAM34044513280; never subtract twice.
ledger.page_table_basis: Each of60 [B,8192] int32 row-major maps reserves ceil(B/8)*8*32768 bytes across8 banks.
ledger.reconciliation_note: Physical tensor inventories reconcile to construction allocator totals with residual bytes by batch: {1: 344576, 32: 393728, 16: 393728, 8: 393728}. These residuals are program allocations/alignment, not omitted weight families. Prepared snapshots additionally include warmed program and retained trace allocations. Trace reservation is excluded from usable capacity already.

reserves.transient_peak_scope: Measured incremental DRAM peak on reduced real layers 0/5, both B1 and B32; not a full-stack peak. NORMAL graph allocation events reconcile exactly to allocator before/after readings.
reserves.budget_basis: Conservative 768 MiB budget exceeds measured cold two-layer prefill peak plus 31 retained selected-logit tiles (31 * 4194304 bytes). Decoder layers execute sequentially and release transient activations. All-layer persistent buffers and trace allocations are accounted separately by prepared allocator snapshots; this budget is an analytical bound, not a measured full-stack peak.

stage_checker: Context and degeneracy pass. Agentic memory checker has only the measured tied-weight representation advisory; no critical finding.
